ticket: Allow partial refunds for an order.
notes: refundOrder is all-or-nothing (paidCents, every line restocked). Partial semantics touch amount-vs-items, tax, restock, cumulative limits and the window.

criticalAmbiguities.description: Partial by amount or by line items/quantities.
How tax and discounts are apportioned in a partial refund.
Whether and how stock is returned for partial refunds.
Multiple partial refunds and the cumulative cap.

unacceptableAssumptions.description: Silently deciding tax is not refunded.
